title: PofBC institutional-history research source register
notes: Source records include both new evidence and corroboration of existing repository history.
Deduplication combines identical normalized URLs, not different documents about the same subject.
Aliases preserve all identifiers used in the report, appendices and mapping files.
Read means relevant substantive material was inspected; it is not an independent audit of every claim in the document.
Indexed-only sources and leads are not equivalent to fully reviewed primary documents.
Dates for fiscal reports refer to their reporting period unless an effective date is expressly stated.
Web reference IDs are retrieval provenance; direct source URLs are the durable citation mechanism.
